custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২৫ কাটা যাবে।

Bank English Preparation.question: ১) "The water is quite cold." The word "quite" is an -
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - Adverb of degree.

• Adverb of degree:
- এই ধরনের adverb কতোখানি, কি মাত্রায় এসব বোঝায়।
- It tells us about the intensity of something.
- Example: Almost, quite, very, much, fully, partly, wholly, completely, strongly, totally, entirely, deeply, greatly, poorly, half, enough, somewhat, altogether, too, little, a little, rather.
- Example Sentence: The water is quite cold.

• Adverb:
- Adverb হলো এমন একটি শব্দ যা verb (ক্রিয়া), adjective (বিশেষণ) অথবা অন্য adverb (ক্রিয়া বিশেষণ)-কে modify বা বিশেষিত করে।

• Adverb of manner:
- যে adverb কোনো কিছু কিভাবে হয় হচ্ছে তা উল্লেখ করে তাকে Adverb of manner বলে।
- Example: sadly, softly, steadily, slowly, soundly, swiftly, simply, suddenly, carefully, carelessly, easily, quickly, possibly, probably, luckily, fortunately, unfortunately, naturally, rightly, urgently, wrongly.
- Example Sentence: He spoke quickly during the meeting.

• Adverb of time:
- এই ধরনের Adverb যে গুলো ক্রিয়া সম্পন্ন হওয়ার সময় বুঝায়। এটি সাধারণত When কখন দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করলে উত্তর দেয়।
- Example: Now, then, before, since, ago, already, once, twice, thrice, again, soon, late, afterwards, yesterday, today, tomorrow, daily. early, formerly, frequently, presently, immediately, instantly.
- Example Sentence: They arrived yesterday at the station.

• Adverb of frequency:
- যে Adverb কোন কিছু করার বা কতো সময় পরপর হয় তা বোঝায় তাকে Adverb of frequency বলে।
- Some Adverb of frequency: always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never etc.
- Example Sentence: He never lies to his friends.

Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. DAS.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২) Choose the correct spelling:
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - খ) Treacherous.

• Treacherous (adjective) 
- English Meaning: that cannot be trusted; intending to harm you
- Bangla Meaning: প্রতারক; বিশ্বাসঘাতক।

• Example Sentence:
- He was betrayed by his treacherous friend.
- The mountain path was narrow and treacherous.

Source:
1. Oxford Learner's Dictionaries.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৩) His ______________ comment made everyone uncomfortable.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Correct answer is - ক) Fatuous.
Complete sentence: His fatuous comment made everyone uncomfortable.

• Fatuous (adjective)
- English Meaning: Stupid, not correct, or not carefully thought about.
- Bangla Meaning: বোকা; জড়বুদ্ধি; বোকার ন্যায় আত্মতুষ্টি প্রদর্শনকারী।

• Synonyms
- Vapid (নীরস; বিস্বাদ; বিরস; নিস্তেজ; নিষ্প্রাণ),
- Besotted (হতবুদ্ধি),
- Inane (অসার; নিঃসার; তুচ্ছ; ফাঁকা)।

• Antonyms:
- Prudent (সুবিবেচক; বিচক্ষণ),
- Sage (জ্ঞানী লোক; মহাপ্রজ্ঞ; ঋষি; প্রাজ্ঞ),
- Sapient (জ্ঞানী; প্রাজ্ঞ)।

• Example Sentence:
- His fatuous comment made everyone uncomfortable.
- It was fatuous to believe the rumor without any proof.

• Other options:
- Factious (adjective) দলাদলিপ্রবণ।
- Sparse (adj) বিরলভাবে বিক্ষিপ্ত।
- Scuffle (verb) (বিশৃঙ্খল মারামারি করা; ধাক্কাধাক্কি করা),

Source:
1. Live MCQ Lecture.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৪) PAIN : SEDATIVE
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - ঘ) Grief : Consolation.

• Pain (noun)
- English Meaning: the feelings that you have in your body when you have been hurt or when you are ill.
- Bangla Meaning: দেহের বা মনের বেদনা; যন্ত্রণা।

• Sedative (noun)
- English Meaning: a drug that makes somebody go to sleep or makes them feel calm and relaxed.
- Bangla Meaning: স্নায়বিক উত্তেজনা ও মানসিক অস্থিরতা প্রশমিত করে এমন (ওষুধ)।

• Grief (noun)
- English Meaning: a very sad feeling, especially when somebody dies.
- Bangla Meaning: প্রচণ্ড দুঃখ; তীব্র শোক; মর্মপীড়া

• Consolation (noun)
- English Meaning: a thing or person that makes you feel better when you are unhappy or disappointed.
- Bangla Meaning: সান্ত্বনা; প্রবোধ।

Sedative যেমন pain কমায়, তেমনি consolation এর মাধ্যমে grief কমে।
তাই সঠিক উত্তর Grief : Consolation।

• Other options
• Comfort (noun)
- English Meaning: the state of being physically relaxed and free from pain; the state of having a pleasant life, with everything that you need.
- Bangla Meaning: আরাম; স্বস্তি; আয়েশ; তৃপ্তি।

• Stimulant (noun)
- English Meaning: a drug or substance that makes you feel more active and gives you more energy.
- Bangla Meaning: উদ্দীপক; যে বস্তু বা বিষয় উদ্দীপিত করে।

• Ache (noun)
- English Meaning: ​to feel a continuous pain that is not severe.
- Bangla Meaning: অবিরাম অস্বস্তিকর বেদনা; ব্যথা।

• Extraction (noun)
- English Meaning: the act or process of removing or obtaining something from something else.
- Bangla Meaning: বলপূর্বক উৎপাটন বা টেনে বের করার কাজ।

• Trance (noun)
- English Meaning: a state in which somebody seems to be asleep but is aware of what is said to them.
- Bangla Meaning: সমাধি অবস্থা; ঘুমের মতো অবস্থা।

• Narcotic (noun)
- English Meaning: a powerful illegal drug that affects the mind in a harmful way.
- Bangla Meaning: মাদকদ্রব্য।

Source:
1. Oxford Learners Dictionaries.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
3. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question:
৫) "He is hence unable to deny it."
Here, "hence" is an -
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - ক) Adverb of Reason.

• Reason or Purpose
- কোন কাজের কারণ বা উদ্দেশ্য বোঝাতে Adverb of Reason or Purpose হয়।
- এধরণের Adverb-গুলি হলো: Hence, therefore, so, so that ইত্যাদি।
Example:
- He therefore left the school.
- He is hence unable to deny it.
- He is ill so he cannot go to school.
- He works hard so that he can succeed.

• Other options:
Adverb of time:
- এই ধরনের Adverb যে গুলো ক্রিয়া সম্পন্ন হওয়ার সময় বুঝায়। এটি সাধারণত When কখন দিয়ে প্রশ্ন করলে উত্তর দেয়।
- Example: Now, then, before, since, ago, already, once, twice, thrice, again, soon, late, afterwards, yesterday, today, tomorrow, daily. early, formerly, frequently. presently, immediately, instantly.
Example Sentence: They arrived yesterday at the station.

Adverb of manner:
- যে adverb কোনো কিছু কিভাবে হয় হচ্ছে তা উল্লেখ করে তাকে Adverb of manner বলে।
- Example: sadly, softly, steadily, slowly, soundly, swiftly, simply, suddenly, carefully, carelessly, easily, quickly, possibly, probably, luckily, fortunately, unfortunately, naturally, rightly, urgently, wrongly.
Example Sentence: He spoke quickly during the meeting.

Adverb of degree:
- এই ধরনের adverb কতোখানি, কি মাত্রায় এসব বোঝায়।
- It tells us about the intensity of something.
Example: Almost, quite, very, much, fully, partly, wholly, completely, strongly, totally, entirely, deeply, greatly, poorly, half, enough, somewhat, altogether, too, little, a little, rather.
Example Sentence: The water is completely cold.

Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. DAS.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৬) What does "Detest" mean?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Detest means to hate strongly.

• Detest (verb):
- English Meaning: Means to hate someone or something very much.
- Bangla Meaning: তীব্র ঘৃণা করা।

• Synonyms:
- Abhor - ঘৃণা বা অবজ্ঞা করা; ঘৃণাভরে পরিহার করা।
- Loathe - বিরাগ পোষণ করা; দারুণ অপছন্দ করা।
- Despise - অবজ্ঞা/ঘৃণা/তুচ্ছজ্ঞান/উপে ক্ষা/তাচ্ছিল্য করা।

• Antonyms:
- Adore - পূজা/উপাসনা/ভজনা করা; গভীরভাবে ভালোবাসা ও শ্রদ্ধা করা; ভক্তি করা।
- Like - পছন্দ করা; কিছু উপভোগ করা বা আনন্দিত হওয়া।
- Admire - মুগ্ধদৃষ্টিতে তাকানো।

• Example Sentences:
- She detests cruelty to animals.
- I absolutely detest waking up early in the morning.

Source: Live MCQ Vocabulary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৭) Never ________ do it again.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - খ) will I.
The complete sentence - Never will I do it again. 

• Inversion of verb
- প্রশ্ন করতে বা জোর প্রদান করতে বাক্যে subject এর পূর্বে verb ব্যবহৃত হওয়াকে Inversion of verb বলে।

• Negative inversion এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Negative adverb+ Auxiliary verb +Subject+ Principal verb + Extension.
- Negative adverb গুলো হচ্ছে Hardly, Barely, Scarcely, Rarely, Seldom, Very seldom, Never, Never again, Never before, No sooner, No where, Neither, Nor, Little (negative) ইত্যাদি।

• Example sentence:
- No where will you find such a country. 
- Seldom do we have goods returned to us because they are faulty.

Bank English Preparation.question:
৮) Fill in the blank with the correct idiom:
"After missing the deadline, the employee found himself ______."
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - খ) in hot water.
- The complete sentence: After missing the deadline, the employee found himself in hot water.
- Bangla Meaning: ডেডলাইন মিস করায় কর্মচারীটি বিপদের মধ্যে পড়ে গেল।

• Be in the hot water:
English Meaning: to be in or get into a difficult situation in which you are in danger of being criticized or punished.
Bangla Meaning: ঝামেলায় পড়া/ এমন পরিস্থিতিতে পড়া যেখানে বিপদ বা ভর্তসনা বা শাস্তির সম্ভাবনা আছে।

• Ex. Sentence:
- He found himself in hot water over his comments about immigration.
- Bangla Meaning: তার অভিবাসন বিষয়ে মন্তব্যের কারণে সে ঝামেলায় পড়ে গিয়েছিল।

• Other options:
- at someone’s heels - অনুসরণ করা।
- below the belt - অন্যায় বা অবিচারমূলক কাজ।
- bird of passage - অস্থায়ী বাসিন্দা/ যাযাবর।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank English Preparation.question: ৯) Choose the correct sentence:
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - খ) I am better today.

• Double comparative double superlative ইংরেজিতে ব্যবহৃত হয় না।
অর্থাৎ, একই বাক্যে একই adjective এর জন্যে একের অধিক comparative বা superlative degree থাকতে পারে না।

• Example:
- Inc. I am comparatively better today.
- cor. I am better today.
оr, I am comparatively well today.

- Inc. Kobra is more taller than Sogra.
- cor. Kobra is taller than Sogra.

- Inc. This tree is the most tallest of all in this jungle.
- or. This tree is the tallest of all in this jungle.

Source: A passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১০) Alone and most penniless, he was bereft ___ hope.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - ক) of.
Complete sentence: Alone and most penniless, he was bereft of hope.

• Bereft of
- English Meaning: not having (something that is needed, wanted, or expected)
- Bangla Meaning: বঞ্চিত।

• Example Sentence:
- The village was bereft of food and clean water after the flood.
- She felt bereft of comfort after her mother passed away.

Source:
1. Oxford Learners Dictionaries.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১১) Which of the following is a synonym of "Insinuate"?
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Correct answer is - গ) Imply.
- Imply (Verb) (ইঙ্গিত করা)

• Insinuate (Verb)
- English Meaning: To express but not directly state something.
- Bangla Meaning: (১) insinuate something/oneself (into) ধীরে ধীরে সুকৌশলে প্রবেশ করা বা করানো;
(২) insinuate oneself into a person's favour, ধীরে ধীরে সুচতুরভাবে কারো অনুগ্রহভাজন হওয়া।

• Synonyms:
- Imply (ইঙ্গিত করা),
- Hint (ইঙ্গিত/আভাস দেওয়া),
- Indicate (নির্দেশ করা),
- Infiltrate (অনুপ্রবেশ করানো),
- Slip (ফসকিয়ে কোন গোপন কথা ফাঁস হয়ে যাওয়া)।

• Antonyms:
- Announce (ঘোষণা করা),
- Declare (ঘোষণা/বিজ্ঞাত করা),
- Proclaim (প্রকাশ/প্রকটিত করা),
- Define (সঠিক ভাবে বর্ণনা করা),
- Express (প্রকাশ করা)।

• Example Sentence:
- Musicians have the gift of melody; they can insinuate something into the culture.
- Are you insinuating that I won by cheating?

• Other options:
- Jeopardy (noun) বিপদ,
- Grace (noun) অনুগ্রহ; ক্ষমা,
- Appease (verb) শান্ত বা প্রশমিত করা; মেটানো।

Source:
1. Live MCQ Lecture.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১২) Which of the following sentences is correct?
Bank English Preparation.option1: He has the most supreme power.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - খ) He has the supreme power.

• Comparison of Adjective এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Supreme (সর্বোচ্চ, সর্ববৃহৎ), false (মিথ্যা), complete (সম্পূর্ণ), unique (অদ্বিতীয়), universal (বিশ্বজনীন, সর্বজনীন) প্রভৃতি word গুলো superlative এর অর্থ প্রদান করে বলে এদের আগে most বসে না।

• Example:
- Inc. It is the most unique opportunity.
- Cor. It is a unique opportunity.

- Inc. He has the most supreme power.
- Cor. He has the supreme power.

Source: A passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৩) Choose the correct proverb:
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - গ) Great talkers are little doers.
- Bangla meaning: কথায় যারা বড় তারা কাজের বেলায় ঠনঠন।

- প্রবাদ বাক্যের ক্ষেত্রে শব্দের পরিবর্তন করা যায় না বা কোন শব্দের পরিবর্তে তার সমার্থক শব্দ ব্যবহার করা যায় না।
- তাই যেটি প্রচলিত প্রবাদ সেটিই সঠিক হবে।

• More proverbs:
- God helps those who help themselves.
- Bangla meaning: স্বাবলম্বী লোকদের ঈশ্বর সাহায্য করেন।

- Good wine needs no bush.
- Bangla meaning: চেনা বামুনের পৈতার দরকার হয় না।

- Grapes are sour.
- Bangla meaning: আঙুর ফল টক।

- Grasp all, lose all.
- Bangla meaning: অতি লোভে তাতি নষ্ট।

- Great minds think alike.
- Bangla meaning: মহৎ লোকেরা এক রকম চিন্তা করেন।

- Great talkers are little doers.
- Bangla meaning: মুখে বুলি লম্বা কাজে অষ্টরম্ভা / কথায় যারা বড় তারা কাজের বেলায় ঠনঠন।

Source:
1. Live MCQ Lecture.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৪) Choose the correct sentence:
Bank English Preparation.option1: She likes ice cream, and so I did.
Bank English Preparation.option2: She likes ice cream, and so does I.
Bank English Preparation.option3: She likes ice cream, and so I does.
Bank English Preparation.option4: She likes ice cream, and so do I.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct sentence is - ঘ) She likes ice cream, and so do I. 

Affirmative agreement অনুযায়ী Inversion এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Affirmative agreemente এটি হচ্ছে কারো হ্যাঁ -সূচক বাক্যের সাথে মতৈক্য যা একমত প্রকাশ করা।
- বাক্যের প্রথম অংশ হ্যাঁ-সূচক হলে so, too, also ইত্যাদি ব্যবহৃত হবে।
- so Auxiliary verb এর পূর্বে এবং too, also Auxiliary verb এর পরে ব্যবহৃত হয়। অর্থাৎ নিম্নের নিয়ম দুইটি অনুসরণ করতে হবে।

- Rule-01 Subject + positive verb +...+and+so+ auxiliary verb + Subject
- Example: She took pictures, and so did I. (সে ছবি তুললো, এবং আমিও তাই করলাম)।

- Rule-02 Subject + positive verb +...+ and + Subject + auxiliary verb + too/also
- Example: She took pictures, and I did too/also, (সে ছবি তুললো, এবং আমিও তাই করলাম)।

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৫) Which sentence contains an adverb of manner?
Bank English Preparation.option3: He never lies to his parents.
Bank English Preparation.option4: He spoke quickly during the meeting.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - ঘ) He spoke quickly during the meeting.

• Adverb of manner:
- যে adverb কোনো কিছু কিভাবে হয় হচ্ছে তা উল্লেখ করে তাকে Adverb of manner বলে।
- Example: sadly, softly, steadily, slowly, soundly, swiftly, simply, suddenly, carefully, carelessly, easily, quickly, possibly, probably, luckily, fortunately, unfortunately, naturally, rightly, urgently, wrongly.
- Example Sentence: He spoke quickly during the meeting.

• Other options:
ক) He always comes late.
- এখানে always হচ্ছে Adverb of Frequency (কতবার বা কত ঘন ঘন ঘটে তা বোঝায়)।

খ) They arrived yesterday.
- এখানে yesterday হচ্ছে Adverb of Time (কখন কিছু ঘটেছে তা বোঝায়)।

গ) He never lies to his parents.
- এখানে never হচ্ছে Adverb of Frequency (ঘটনার ঘনত্ব বোঝায় - কখনোই না)।

Source: Applied English Grammar and Composition by P. C. DAS.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৬) Substitution for a 'Plutocracy' will be -
Bank English Preparation.option2: A government by a king or a queen
Bank English Preparation.exp:
A government by the wealthy is called Plutocracy.

• Plutocracy
- English Meaning: A government by the wealthy.
- বাংলা অর্থ: ধনিকগোষ্ঠী।

• Other options:
- A body of nonelected government officials - Bureaucracy (আমলাতন্ত্র)।
- A government by a king or a queen - Monarchy (রাজতন্ত্র),
- A government in which one person - Autocracy (একনায়কতন্ত্র),

Source: 1. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question:
১৭) Complete the sentence:
Only after food has been dried or canned ______________________.
Bank English Preparation.option1: that it should be stored for later consumption.
Bank English Preparation.option2: should be stored for later consumption.
Bank English Preparation.option3: should it be stored for later consumption.
Bank English Preparation.option4: it should be stored for later consumption.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct sentence: গ) should it be stored for later consumption.

• Negative inversion এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- Negative adverb +Clause+ Auxiliary verb +Subject+ Principal verb + Extension.
- Adverb গুলো হচ্ছে Only after, only because, only if, only when, only until, not until ইত্যাদি।

• Complete sentence: Only after food has been dried or canned should it be stored for later consumption.

• Example sentence:
- Not until he got home did he realize that he had lost the book.
- Only after they had finished eating did they get round to business.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৮) Identify the antonym of "Reticent":
Bank English Preparation.exp:
Garrulous is an antonym of "Reticent".
- Garrulous (adjective) বাচাল; বাক্যবাগীশ।

• Reticent (adjective)
- English Meaning: Unwilling to speak about your thoughts or feelings.
- Bangla Meaning: স্বল্পভাষী, গুরুগম্ভীর।

• Synonyms:
- Reserved (গুরুগম্ভীর),
- Introverted (অন্তর্মুখী),
- Uncommunicative (মুখবোজা চাপাস্বভাব),
- Untalkative (নীরব),
- Silent (মৌন),
- Bashful (লাজুক)।

• Antonyms:
- Expansive (উচ্ছল, উচ্ছলিত; উচ্ছলতাপূর্ণ),
- Garrulous (বাক্যবাগীশ),
- Communicative (আলাপ),
- Extrovert (বহির্মুখী),
- Talkative (বাচাল)।

• Other Forms:
- Reticence (রেটিসনস্] (noun) [uncountable noun] স্বল্পভাষিতা, বাকসংযম।

• Example Sentence:
- She was extremely reticent about her personal affairs.
- He was reticent to gossip about others' affairs.

• Other options:
- Regard (noun) দীর্ঘ; স্থির,
- Exhaust (noun) নির্গম নল,
- Castigate (verb) প্রহার বা তীব্র নিন্দা জানিয়ে কঠোর শান্তি দেওয়া।

Source:
1. Live MCQ Lecture.
2. Accessible Dictionary.

Bank English Preparation.question: ১৯) Choose the correct sentence:
Bank English Preparation.option1: She is the more beautiful of the two girls.
Bank English Preparation.option2: She is more beautiful of the two girls.
Bank English Preparation.option3: She is beautiful than the other girl.
Bank English Preparation.option4: She is most beautiful between them.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - ক) She is the more beautiful of the two girls.

• Comparative degree এর ক্ষেত্রে,
- দুইয়ের মধ্যে তুলনা বুঝাতে comparative এবং দুইয়ের অধিকের মধ্যে তুলনা বুঝাতে superlative degree ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- Inc. She is the most beautiful of the two girls.
- cor. She is the more beautiful of the two girls.
- Comparative-এর আগে the বসে না, কিন্তু two-কথাটি উল্লেখ থাকলে তার আগে the ব্যবহৃত হয়।

- Inc. He is taller boy in the class.
- cor. He is taller than any other boy in the class.

- Inc. Two boys named Kalim and Salim came here-I know the last.
- cor. Two boys named Kalim and Salim come here-I know the latter.

Source: A passage to the English Language by S.M. Zakir Hussain.

Bank English Preparation.question: ২০) The soldier ___________ the enemy's line.
Bank English Preparation.exp:
The correct answer is - গ) broke through.
- The complete sentence: The soldier broke through the enemy's line.
- Bangla meaning: সৈনিকটি শত্রুর প্রতিরক্ষা রেখা ভেঙে ঢুকে পড়ল।

• Break through 
- English Meaning: get through by force.
- Bangla Meaning: জোর করে ঢোকা।
- Example sentence: The soldier broke through the enemy's line.

• Other options:
- Break off  (stop suddenly, হঠাৎ থামিয়া যাওয়া) - The speaker broke off in the middle of his speech.
- Break in, on (interrupt, বাঁধা দেওয়া) - You should not break in (on) our conversation.
- Break up (close, বন্ধ হওয়া)-Our school breaks up at 4. p.m.

• More:
- Break away (get away, ভাঙ্গিয়া বাহির হইয়া আসা)-The convict broke away from the prison.
- Break down (decline, ভাঙিয়া পড়া বা দুর্বল হইয়া পড়া)-His health broke down for hard work.
- Break into (enter by force, ভাঙ্গিয়া প্রবেশ করা)-The robber broke into the house in midnight.
- Break with (quarrel, ঝগড়া করা)- He has broken with his friend.

Source: Applied English Grammar & Composition, P.C. DAS.
